data_fields.name: stepMinutes
data_fields.donor_constant: 30 (countdown step, one call per geoscape half hour)

data_fields.name: spacingLowRatio
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.5 of the wave timer (T/2 with T = spawnTimer/30 in integer half hours)

data_fields.name: spacingHighRatio
data_fields.donor_constant: 1.5 of the wave timer (T/2 + RNG(0,T) half hours)

data_fields.name: shotDownDelayMin
data_fields.donor_constant: 30 * (RNG(0,400) + 48) minutes added, i.e. 24 h to 224 h; skipped on the last wave

data_fields.name: reachBaseResetMin
data_fields.donor_constant: 30 * (RNG(0,400) + 48) minutes assigned, i.e. 24 h to 224 h

data_fields.name: missionPoints
data_fields.donor_constant: ruleset points per mission; no literal default beyond 0

best_idea: Make a mission's finish a pure state test (no waves left and no live enemies), pay each objective on its own event (site on landing, base on completion, other objectives on lifting), and let a kill push the next wave back by a rolled delay.
decision_why: The finish test and the pay-by-objective rule fit quest and event objectives on the server; the spacing needs the rounding and documentation fixes, and the reward sign is inverted (the donor pays the enemy), so Frankendom takes it as a zone threat meter instead.
acceptance: Server test: a two-wave site event is over only after the last wave is out and every UFO is gone; a landed UFO pays the zone meter once on lifting; a base objective pays only when the base is placed; a shot-down UFO delays the next wave by a rolled amount within the documented range; a 45-minute spacing rolls between about 23 and 68 minutes, not 0 or 30.
